title: Baglietto Sells First T54 54m Superyacht by Francesco Paszkowski with 2027 Delivery
description: Baglietto confirms first T54 superyacht sale — a 54m Francesco Paszkowski design with a 2027 delivery, expanding the yard’s 50–60m T-line offerings.
html:
Baglietto Sells First T54 Superyacht with 2027 Delivery

Baglietto has confirmed the first sale of its new T54 superyacht model, marking the introduction of a 54-metre addition to the yard’s T-line. The transaction establishes the T54 as an in-build project with a scheduled delivery in 2027, signalling client confidence in Baglietto’s next-generation offering and reinforcing the yard’s presence in the 50–60 metre segment.

The T54 is a Francesco Paszkowski design and represents the larger iteration of the T-series. Baglietto’s announcement highlights that the model is progressing through construction planning and that the shipyard expects to meet the 2027 delivery window for this initial hull.

T54 Evolves T52 Design with Increased Volume Under 500GT

The T54 carries forward the classic, masculine lines of the smaller T52 while increasing internal volume to provide greater onboard accommodation and circulation. Despite the growth in size and internal rearrangement, Baglietto has confirmed the model retains a tonnage rating below 500GT, preserving regulatory and operational characteristics relevant to owners and operators.

Design continuity is evident in proportions and exterior language, but the added length enables specific enhancements to guest spaces and technical layouts. While interior fit-out details remain largely undisclosed, the shipyard has indicated a larger master suite with a private veranda and the inclusion of an additional upper-deck guest cabin as direct benefits of the increased hull length.

Expanded Aft, Wellness, Sundeck and Three-Sided Skylounge

The aft configuration follows the T52’s three-interconnected-level arrangement but on a larger scale. The extended volume allows for a dedicated lounge area surrounding an infinity pool and a wellness suite comprising a spa and gym, both arranged for direct access from the beach platform to improve circulation between waterline amenities and interior wellness spaces.

Other notable exterior features include a sundeck expanded to approximately 150 square metres and a skylounge that preserves the T-line’s three-sided opening concept. Baglietto has also reallocated technical spaces in this layout to enable the main saloon to open onto the outer deck with floor-to-ceiling glazing, increasing visual connection and natural light in principal living areas.

Market Impact: Baglietto T54 Sale, Specs and Orderbook

The T54 will be powered by Caterpillar C32 engines as standard, with the naval architecture also specified to accept hybrid propulsion packages should an owner opt for them. This flexibility reflects industry trends toward hybridisation while retaining proven diesel options for range and reliability.

Baglietto currently lists 12 yacht projects either on order or under construction, demonstrating a busy production pipeline; among these is a 56-metre custom build penned by Enrico Gobbi – Team for Design. The sale of the T54 adds a semi-custom option to that pipeline and will serve as a benchmark for client demand and further iterations within the T series as the yard moves toward the planned 2027 delivery.
